messages:
samantha: (support) acme reports p99 latency spike after runtime patch; streaming TTFB stable (~120ms) but total time p99 up to 6.2s since ~2026-03-15 03:21 UTC. customer: 'we see the first chunk immediately but final response arrives late'.

kai: (eng) looking at dashboards — p95 steady, p99 spike matches per-worker streaming stalls. metrics: https://dash/reds/12345 :eyes:

julio: (runtime) deploy-bot shows rollout runtime-v2.14 at 2026-03-15T03:21Z. any proxy changes? could be coalescing heuristics or async flush backpressure.

deploy-bot: Deploy runtime-v2.14 to production by ci/cd (id: dpl-9928) - started 2026-03-15T03:21:12Z

samantha: attached recent customer logs (request_id=acme-req-72):
```
[2026-03-15T03:22:10Z] write stalled: wrote chunk 1 (120b) ok
[2026-03-15T03:22:16Z] attempted flush but backlog > window, delayed 5.8s
[2026-03-15T03:22:16Z] final chunk write completed
```

maia: (sre) seeing worker TX queue growth at same times; concurrent streaming sessions per-worker rose ~2.3x after the patch. Coalesce window was widened from 10ms -> 50ms on v2.14.

julio: (runtime) repro steps I used locally:
```
# reproduce with http2 streaming
python tools/stream_repro.py --host api.redwood.test --tenant acme --concurrency 40 --prompt 'long' --duration 60
```
Result: occasional mid-chunk stall at ~p99. Observed flush latency tied to coalescer backlog.

kai: quick mitigations:
- rollback runtime-v2.14 coalesce change (fast)
- tenant-scoped override: set coalesce.window_ms=10 for acme (hotfix)
- route heavy streaming traffic to dedicated nodes (config)

julio: I'll prepare a canary hotfix: force flush if chunk prefix hasn't progressed in 100ms and payload > 1 token.

customer-support: Customer is pushing back, asking for ETA on fix and temporary workaround. Offered routing to non-streaming endpoint (would increase total tokens/cost but reduces user impact). Can we enable tenant override now?

maia: I can flip tenant override TTL 1h now. doing it in 2 mins and will monitor p99.

samantha: please confirm once override is active, I'll inform customer and update the support ticket.

maia: override active for tenant=acme: coalesce.window_ms=10 (applied at 2026-03-15T04:02Z) :thumbsup:

julio: patch queued to canary (runtime-v2.14.1) to add emergency flush; will monitor canary metrics and promote if stable.

kai: long-term followups: refine coalescer to consider per-tenant latency SLOs, add adaptive flush when KV cache miss/higher backlog, add alert for p99 streaming stalls.

samantha: thanks all — I'll keep customer updated and close loop once metrics confirm p99 back to baseline. filing postmortem note in #postmortems.
